scripts.cf-typegen: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/oneworld-insights-wrangler.log pnpm --dir ../.. exec wrangler types infra/insights/worker-configuration.d.ts --config infra/insights/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface InsightsEnv
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run catalog && pnpm run cf-typegen && pnpm --dir ../.. exec tsc --project infra/insights/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run catalog && pnpm --dir ../.. exec vitest run --config infra/insights/vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.deploy: pnpm run check && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/oneworld-insights-wrangler.log pnpm --dir ../.. exec wrangler deploy --config infra/insights/wrangler.jsonc --strict
